definitions.explanation: An exaggerated, conspicuously large yawn, often implying boredom, extreme sleepiness, or lack of interest.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was told off for yawning wide during a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧な⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: While watching the boring movie, I yawned widely again and again.

notes:
Combines the prefix {大|おお} (big, great) with あくび (yawn). Emphasizes the conspicuous size of the yawn. Often used when the yawning is noticed by others and considered rude or inappropriate in context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a big yawn
- {大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to yawn repeatedly
- {大|おお}あくび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a big yawn comes out (involuntarily)
- {大|おお}あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す→噛み殺す：29106_kamikorosu⟧: to stifle a big yawn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あくび: yawn — the plain form without emphasis on size
- ⟦{欠伸|あくび}→欠伸：06484_akubi⟧: yawn — kanji spelling, same word as あくび
